note: Machine-readable enums and limits. README.md is the same rules for humans; change enums here, not only in README.
_activities_note: EXAMPLE list -- edit it to match the kinds of work your team does. check.py and add.py refuse any activity not listed here, so a typo can never make a card silently unmatchable.

illegal_combinations.why: An inference cannot be a hard boundary. Either downgrade it to assumption, or pin down the source first and then upgrade it.
A hard boundary cannot rely on 'hopefully retrieval finds it'. Either raise it to skill/resident/gated/code/eliminated, or admit it is really guidance.

_review_months_note: Review interval by source tier: the softer the source, the more often it is reviewed.
_source_tier_note: The two ladders must not be mixed: an internal boundary's authority comes from who said it and where; an external boundary's authority comes from the rank of the text. domain decides which ladder applies; audit E011 enforces it.
_acquisition_note: acquisition describes how this card will be re-verified later. It is orthogonal to domain (where the rule comes from) and source_tier (its authority): an internal policy document may be re-fetchable, while a customer's confirmation given over the phone is external but can only be re-asked. unrecorded = it was verified once but neither the address nor a copy was kept; the companion field reacquire says how to obtain the original at review time, turning a dead end into a to-do. Do not use human_only to paper over it -- that disguises a fixable problem as an unfixable one.
_applicability_note: When domain=external and force=binding, applicability is required: a text existing is not the same as it applying. Example: a guideline written for teams of under 50 people, cited as binding for a 500-person organisation -- the guideline exists, but whether it applies is unconfirmed. If you cannot fill in applicability, it is not confirmed, so the card cannot be binding.
_hard_value_note: Optional machine-checkable thresholds on a constraint: hard_value: {trigger_any: [{metric: <name>, op: <'<'|'<='|'>'|'>='|'=='>, value: <number>, unit: <text>}]}. audit W002 warns when two active binding cards with overlapping scope give different op/value/unit for the same metric.
_archive_roots_note: Directories (relative to this registry) against which a relative archive_ref is resolved when acquisition=held_copy.
